merge_imagenet_lvis_categories: merge ImageNet-21k and LVIS dataset categories by matching synset and name fields into a unified category list
remap_imagenet_category_ids: remap ImageNet image pos_category_ids to the merged category ID space and filter images with no valid categories
save_merged_imagenet_json: save the merged ImageNet-21k annotation JSON with remapped category IDs to a new output file
save_merged_lvis_json: save the LVIS annotation JSON with the unified merged categories to a new output file
export_categories_python: export the merged category list as a Python CATEGORIES variable to a specified file path
